SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE AND MACT AT KALABURAGI IN MVC.NO.936/2020 AND CONSEQUENTLY BE PLEASED TO DISCHARGE ITS LIABILITY TO PAY THE COMPENSATION AND PLEASE TO REDUCE COMPENSATION AWARDED BY THE TRIBUNAL THIS APPEAL COMING ON FOR CONCILIATION BEFORE LOK ADALAT, THIS DAY, THE FOLLOWING ORDER IS PASSED:
CONCILIATION ORDER
The representative pf the appellant - insurance company and the learned counsel for the respondents - claimants along with their counsel are present.
2. After prolonged negotiations, the matter is settled.

The appellant - insurance company has agreed to pay and respondents - claimants have agreed to receive a sum compensation of Rs.27,50,000/- (Rupees Twenty Seven Lakhs Fifty Thousand only),
in addition to what has been awarded by the Tribunal, in full and final settlement of the claim.
3. Out of the agreed - compromised amount, the appellant - insurance company has already deposited Rs.25,000/- towards statutory deposit before this Court.
Hence, the same shall be transmitted to the Tribunal and appellant - insurance company has to pay balance amount of Rs.27,25,000/-.

4. The appellant - insurance company has agreed to deposit the balance amount of Rs.27,25,000/-
(Rupees Twenty Seven Lakhs Twenty Five Thousand only) before the Tribunal within eight weeks from the date of preparation of award, failing which the said amount shall carry interest at 0% p.a.
from the date of default, till the date of deposit.
The parties are not entitled to any cost.
5. A joint Memo is filed on behalf of the parties to this effect.
Same is accepted.
6. The respondents No.1 to 3 are entitled for 40%, 30% and 30% share each respectively.

7. The entire amount of the shares shall be released in favour of the respondents No.1 and 2 - claimants No.1 and 2.
8.
The entire share of minor respondent No.3 - claimant No.3 is to be deposited in any of the nationalized bank of the choice of respondent No.1 - claimant No.1 till he attains the age of majority.
